name: MedFlash
image_caption: Live dark-mode medical board review workspace at mcqrecall.netlify.app.
tagline: A physician-built medical board review engine that converts raw MCQ PDFs into structured active-recall study sessions.
problem: Medical students and house officers lose hours manually re-formatting past-question PDFs instead of drilling clinical reasoning under timed exam pressure.
overview: Built from firsthand MBBS clinical board preparation, MedFlash transforms multi-file MCQ PDFs into focused active-recall study sessions—paired with an integrated Pomodoro focus timer and longitudinal revision history.
impact: Automates medical question ingestion via multi-PDF drag-and-drop parsing (Correct Answer X format).
Combines clinical active recall, timed Pomodoro blocks, and session history inside a low-fatigue dark interface.
Live and immediately testable with zero signup friction on Netlify.
features: Multi-file drag-and-drop PDF uploader with automatic MCQ & answer-key extraction
Each uploaded PDF becomes an organized, resumable active-recall study session
Integrated Pomodoro timer engineered for high-volume medical exam revision
Persistent study history, progress tracking, and customizable review settings
role: Physician Founder, Clinical UX Designer & Builder
